core_obligations: Note that strict transforms under a blowup of S remain quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and reduce the lemma to finding a U-admissible blowup whose strict transform is flat and locally of finite presentation (proof lines 9138-9142).

Reduce to X affine by taking a finite affine open cover X = W_1 union ... union W_n and using the existence of a U-admissible blowup dominating the finitely many solutions S_i -> S obtained for the W_i (proof lines 9143-9150).

For affine X, choose an immersion j : X -> A^n_S into a quasi-compact open V of the affine space in which j is a closed immersion, apply the flattening theorem to V -> S and the quasi-coherent module i_*O_X to obtain S' -> S, and let X' be the strict transform of X with respect to S' -> S with induced i' : X' -> V x_S S' (proof lines 9153-9164).

Conclude that i'_*O_{X'} is flat over S' and of finite presentation as a module on V x_S S', using that taking strict transform commutes with pushforward along the affine morphism i, and deduce the two required properties of X' over S' (proof lines 9165-9169).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to local finite presentation and to the affine case by a finite affine cover plus a dominating admissible blowup (proof lines 9138-9150).
Embed the affine X into an affine space over S and apply the flattening theorem to the pushforward of its structure sheaf (proof lines 9153-9164).
Transport flatness back from the strict transform of the pushforward to the strict transform of X via affine pushforward (proof lines 9165-9169).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that for X -> S of finite type and quasi-separated whose restriction to a quasi-compact open U is flat and locally of finite presentation, some U-admissible blowup S' -> S has strict transform flat and of finite presentation over S' (statement lines 9122-9135). The proof is a reduction: strict transforms remain quasi-compact and quasi-separated, so local finite presentation may be proved first; a finite affine open cover X = W_1 union ... union W_n allows the conclusion for X to be assembled from the conclusions for the W_i once a U-admissible blowup dominating all of them is chosen, using the existence of a common refinement of admissible blowups; and for affine X one embeds X as a closed subscheme of a quasi-compact open V of A^n_S and applies the flattening theorem to the pushforward i_*O_X, then uses that strict transform commutes with pushforward along an affine morphism, which converts flatness of the strict transform of i_*O_X into flatness of i'_*O_{X'} and hence of X' over S' (proof lines 9138-9169). The choice of the ambient affine space, the use of the flattening theorem on a pushforward rather than on X itself, and the strict-transform-commutes-with-pushforward step are the non-formal content, so the claim is H2.
